demo.program:
# Niels Bohr — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What field did Niels Bohr work in?", "physics"),
    ("What is Niels Bohr known for?", "atomic model, quantum theory"),
    ("What is lived?", "1885-1962"),
    ("What is field?", "physics"),
    ("What is known for?", "atomic model, quantum theory"),
    ("What is note?", "1922 Nobel; the Bohr atom"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
